en.text: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

zhSimplified.text: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他做了梦，心里烦乱，不能睡觉。

zhTraditional.text: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他做了夢，心裏煩亂，不能睡覺。

en.text: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.

zhSimplified.text: 王吩咐人将术士、用法术的、行邪术的，和迦勒底人召来，要他们将王的梦告诉王，他们就来站在王前。

zhTraditional.text: 王吩咐人將術士、用法術的、行邪術的，和迦勒底人召來，要他們將王的夢告訴王，他們就來站在王前。

en.text: The king said to them, “I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.”

zhSimplified.text: 王对他们说：「我做了一梦，心里烦乱，要知道这是什么梦。」

zhTraditional.text: 王對他們說：「我做了一夢，心裏煩亂，要知道這是甚麼夢。」

en.text: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒底人用亚兰的言语对王说：「愿王万岁！请将那梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解。」

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒底人用亞蘭的言語對王說：「願王萬歲！請將那夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解。」

en.text: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.

zhSimplified.text: 王回答迦勒底人说：「梦我已经忘了，你们若不将梦和梦的讲解告诉我，就必被凌迟，你们的房屋必成为粪堆；

zhTraditional.text: 王回答迦勒底人說：「夢我已經忘了，你們若不將夢和夢的講解告訴我，就必被凌遲，你們的房屋必成為糞堆；

en.text: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”

zhSimplified.text: 你们若将梦和梦的讲解告诉我，就必从我这里得赠品和赏赐，并大尊荣。现在你们要将梦和梦的讲解告诉我。」

zhTraditional.text: 你們若將夢和夢的講解告訴我，就必從我這裏得贈品和賞賜，並大尊榮。現在你們要將夢和夢的講解告訴我。」

en.text: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们第二次对王说：「请王将梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們第二次對王說：「請王將夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解。」

en.text: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.

zhSimplified.text: 王回答说：「我准知道你们是故意迟延，因为你们知道那梦我已经忘了。

zhTraditional.text: 王回答說：「我准知道你們是故意遲延，因為你們知道那夢我已經忘了。

en.text: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”

zhSimplified.text: 你们若不将梦告诉我，只有一法待你们；因为你们预备了谎言乱语向我说，要等候时势改变。现在你们要将梦告诉我，因我知道你们能将梦的讲解告诉我。」

zhTraditional.text: 你們若不將夢告訴我，只有一法待你們；因為你們預備了謊言亂語向我說，要等候時勢改變。現在你們要將夢告訴我，因我知道你們能將夢的講解告訴我。」

en.text: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler has asked such a thing of any magician, enchanter, or Chaldean.

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒底人在王面前回答说：「世上没有人能将王所问的事说出来；因为没有君王、大臣、掌权的向术士，或用法术的，或迦勒底人问过这样的事。

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒底人在王面前回答說：「世上沒有人能將王所問的事說出來；因為沒有君王、大臣、掌權的向術士，或用法術的，或迦勒底人問過這樣的事。

en.text: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.”

zhSimplified.text: 王所问的事甚难。除了不与世人同居的神明，没有人在王面前能说出来。」

zhTraditional.text: 王所問的事甚難。除了不與世人同居的神明，沒有人在王面前能說出來。」

en.text: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.

zhSimplified.text: 因此，王气忿忿地大发烈怒，吩咐灭绝巴比伦所有的哲士。

zhTraditional.text: 因此，王氣忿忿地大發烈怒，吩咐滅絕巴比倫所有的哲士。

en.text: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.

zhSimplified.text: 于是命令发出，哲士将要见杀，人就寻找但以理和他的同伴，要杀他们。

zhTraditional.text: 於是命令發出，哲士將要見殺，人就尋找但以理和他的同伴，要殺他們。

en.text: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 王的护卫长亚略出来，要杀巴比伦的哲士，但以理就用婉言回答他，

zhTraditional.text: 王的護衛長亞略出來，要殺巴比倫的哲士，但以理就用婉言回答他，

en.text: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

zhSimplified.text: 向王的护卫长亚略说：「王的命令为何这样紧急呢？」亚略就将情节告诉但以理。

zhTraditional.text: 向王的護衛長亞略說：「王的命令為何這樣緊急呢？」亞略就將情節告訴但以理。

en.text: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

zhSimplified.text: 但以理遂进去求王宽限，就可以将梦的讲解告诉王。

zhTraditional.text: 但以理遂進去求王寬限，就可以將夢的講解告訴王。

en.text: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

zhSimplified.text: 但以理回到他的居所，将这事告诉他的同伴哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅，

zhTraditional.text: 但以理回到他的居所，將這事告訴他的同伴哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅，

en.text: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 要他们祈求天上的 神施怜悯，将这奥秘的事指明，免得但以理和他的同伴与巴比伦其余的哲士一同灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 要他們祈求天上的上帝施憐憫，將這奧祕的事指明，免得但以理和他的同伴與巴比倫其餘的哲士一同滅亡。

en.text: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 这奥秘的事就在夜间异象中给但以理显明，但以理便称颂天上的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 這奧祕的事就在夜間異象中給但以理顯明，但以理便稱頌天上的上帝。

en.text: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

zhSimplified.text: 但以理说：「 神的名是应当称颂的！从亘古直到永远，因为智慧能力都属乎他。

zhTraditional.text: 但以理說：「上帝的名是應當稱頌的！從亙古直到永遠，因為智慧能力都屬乎他。

en.text: He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding.

zhSimplified.text: 他改变时候、日期，废王，立王，将智慧赐与智慧人，将知识赐与聪明人。

zhTraditional.text: 他改變時候、日期，廢王，立王，將智慧賜與智慧人，將知識賜與聰明人。

en.text: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

zhSimplified.text: 他显明深奥隐秘的事，知道暗中所有的，光明也与他同居。

zhTraditional.text: 他顯明深奧隱秘的事，知道暗中所有的，光明也與他同居。

en.text: I thank you and praise you, O God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king’s matter.”

zhSimplified.text: 我列祖的 神啊，我感谢你，赞美你；因你将智慧才能赐给我，允准我们所求的，把王的事给我们指明。」

zhTraditional.text: 我列祖的上帝啊，我感謝你，讚美你；因你將智慧才能賜給我，允准我們所求的，把王的事給我們指明。」

en.text: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said this to him: “Don’t destroy the wise men of Babylon. Bring me in before the king, and I will show to the king the interpretation.”

zhSimplified.text: 于是，但以理进去见亚略，就是王所派灭绝巴比伦哲士的，对他说：「不要灭绝巴比伦的哲士，求你领我到王面前，我要将梦的讲解告诉王。」

zhTraditional.text: 於是，但以理進去見亞略，就是王所派滅絕巴比倫哲士的，對他說：「不要滅絕巴比倫的哲士，求你領我到王面前，我要將夢的講解告訴王。」

en.text: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said this to him: “I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation.”

zhSimplified.text: 亚略就急忙将但以理领到王面前，对王说：「我在被掳的犹大人中遇见一人，他能将梦的讲解告诉王。」

zhTraditional.text: 亞略就急忙將但以理領到王面前，對王說：「我在被擄的猶大人中遇見一人，他能將夢的講解告訴王。」

en.text: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?”

zhSimplified.text: 王问称为伯提沙撒的但以理说：「你能将我所做的梦和梦的讲解告诉我吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 王問稱為伯提沙撒的但以理說：「你能將我所做的夢和夢的講解告訴我嗎？」

en.text: Daniel answered before the king, and said, “The secret which the king has demanded can’t be shown to the king by wise men, enchanters, magicians, or soothsayers;

zhSimplified.text: 但以理在王面前回答说：「王所问的那奥秘事，哲士、用法术的、术士、观兆的都不能告诉王，

zhTraditional.text: 但以理在王面前回答說：「王所問的那奧祕事，哲士、用法術的、術士、觀兆的都不能告訴王，

en.text: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head on your bed are these:

zhSimplified.text: 只有一位在天上的 神能显明奥秘的事。他已将日后必有的事指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的梦和你在床上脑中的异象是这样：

zhTraditional.text: 只有一位在天上的上帝能顯明奧祕的事。他已將日後必有的事指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的夢和你在床上腦中的異象是這樣：

en.text: “As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.

zhSimplified.text: 王啊，你在床上想到后来的事，那显明奥秘事的主把将来必有的事指示你。

zhTraditional.text: 王啊，你在床上想到後來的事，那顯明奧祕事的主把將來必有的事指示你。

en.text: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.

zhSimplified.text: 至于那奥秘的事显明给我，并非因我的智慧胜过一切活人，乃为使王知道梦的讲解和心里的思念。

zhTraditional.text: 至於那奧祕的事顯明給我，並非因我的智慧勝過一切活人，乃為使王知道夢的講解和心裏的思念。

en.text: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.

footnotes.text: 2:31 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 「王啊，你梦见一个大像，这像甚高，极其光耀，站在你面前，形状甚是可怕。

zhTraditional.text: 「王啊，你夢見一個大像，這像甚高，極其光耀，站在你面前，形狀甚是可怕。

en.text: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,

zhSimplified.text: 这像的头是精金的，胸膛和膀臂是银的，肚腹和腰是铜的，

zhTraditional.text: 這像的頭是精金的，胸膛和膀臂是銀的，肚腹和腰是銅的，

en.text: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron and part of clay.

zhSimplified.text: 腿是铁的，脚是半铁半泥的。

zhTraditional.text: 腿是鐵的，腳是半鐵半泥的。

en.text: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.

zhSimplified.text: 你观看，见有一块非人手凿出来的石头打在这像半铁半泥的脚上，把脚砸碎；

zhTraditional.text: 你觀看，見有一塊非人手鑿出來的石頭打在這像半鐵半泥的腳上，把腳砸碎；

en.text: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors. The wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.

zhSimplified.text: 于是金、银、铜、铁、泥都一同砸得粉碎，成如夏天禾场上的糠秕，被风吹散，无处可寻。打碎这像的石头变成一座大山，充满天下。

zhTraditional.text: 於是金、銀、銅、鐵、泥都一同砸得粉碎，成如夏天禾場上的糠詷，被風吹散，無處可尋。打碎這像的石頭變成一座大山，充滿天下。

en.text: “This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.

zhSimplified.text: 「这就是那梦；我们在王面前要讲解那梦。

zhTraditional.text: 「這就是那夢；我們在王面前要講解那夢。

en.text: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

zhSimplified.text: 王啊，你是诸王之王。天上的 神已将国度、权柄、能力、尊荣都赐给你。

zhTraditional.text: 王啊，你是諸王之王。天上的上帝已將國度、權柄、能力、尊榮都賜給你。

en.text: Wherever the children of men dwell, he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand, and has made you rule over them all. You are the head of gold.

zhSimplified.text: 凡世人所住之地的走兽，并天空的飞鸟，他都交付你手，使你掌管这一切。你就是那金头。

zhTraditional.text: 凡世人所住之地的走獸，並天空的飛鳥，他都交付你手，使你掌管這一切。你就是那金頭。

en.text: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 在你以后必另兴一国，不及于你；又有第三国，就是铜的，必掌管天下。

zhTraditional.text: 在你以後必另興一國，不及於你；又有第三國，就是銅的，必掌管天下。

en.text: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.

zhSimplified.text: 第四国，必坚壮如铁，铁能打碎克制百物，又能压碎一切，那国也必打碎压制列国。

zhTraditional.text: 第四國，必堅壯如鐵，鐵能打碎剋制百物，又能壓碎一切，那國也必打碎壓制列國。

en.text: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

zhSimplified.text: 你既见像的脚和脚指头，一半是窑匠的泥，一半是铁，那国将来也必分开。你既见铁与泥搀杂，那国也必有铁的力量。

zhTraditional.text: 你既見像的腳和腳指頭，一半是窯匠的泥，一半是鐵，那國將來也必分開。你既見鐵與泥攙雜，那國也必有鐵的力量。

en.text: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

zhSimplified.text: 那脚指头，既是半铁半泥，那国也必半强半弱。

zhTraditional.text: 那腳指頭，既是半鐵半泥，那國也必半強半弱。

en.text: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they will mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they won’t cling to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.

zhSimplified.text: 你既见铁与泥搀杂，那国民也必与各种人搀杂，却不能彼此相合，正如铁与泥不能相合一样。

zhTraditional.text: 你既見鐵與泥攙雜，那國民也必與各種人攙雜，卻不能彼此相合，正如鐵與泥不能相合一樣。

en.text: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.

zhSimplified.text: 当那列王在位的时候，天上的 神必另立一国，永不败坏，也不归别国的人，却要打碎灭绝那一切国，这国必存到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 當那列王在位的時候，天上的上帝必另立一國，永不敗壞，也不歸別國的人，卻要打碎滅絕那一切國，這國必存到永遠。

en.text: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”

zhSimplified.text: 你既看见非人手凿出来的一块石头从山而出，打碎金、银、铜、铁、泥，那就是至大的 神把后来必有的事给王指明。这梦准是这样，这讲解也是确实的。」

zhTraditional.text: 你既看見非人手鑿出來的一塊石頭從山而出，打碎金、銀、銅、鐵、泥，那就是至大的上帝把後來必有的事給王指明。這夢準是這樣，這講解也是確實的。」

en.text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.

zhSimplified.text: 当时，尼布甲尼撒王俯伏在地，向但以理下拜，并且吩咐人给他奉上供物和香品。

zhTraditional.text: 當時，尼布甲尼撒王俯伏在地，向但以理下拜，並且吩咐人給他奉上供物和香品。

en.text: The king answered to Daniel, and said, “Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret.”

zhSimplified.text: 王对但以理说：「你既能显明这奥秘的事，你们的 神诚然是万神之神、万王之主，又是显明奥秘事的。」

zhTraditional.text: 王對但以理說：「你既能顯明這奧祕的事，你們的上帝誠然是萬神之神、萬王之主，又是顯明奧祕事的。」

en.text: Then the king made Daniel great and gave him many great gifts, and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 于是王高抬但以理，赏赐他许多上等礼物，派他管理巴比伦全省，又立他为总理，掌管巴比伦的一切哲士。

zhTraditional.text: 於是王高抬但以理，賞賜他許多上等禮物，派他管理巴比倫全省，又立他為總理，掌管巴比倫的一切哲士。

en.text: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon, but Daniel was in the king’s gate.

zhSimplified.text: 但以理求王，王就派沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌管理巴比伦省的事务，只是但以理常在朝中侍立。

zhTraditional.text: 但以理求王，王就派沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌管理巴比倫省的事務，只是但以理常在朝中侍立。
